block.deidentified_recipient: a de-identified recipient cannot receive real mail
block.external_writes_disabled_in_settin: real writes are off in settings
block.no_real_account_for_this_draft: no real account for this draft
block.sample_source_has_no_writable_acco: sample source has no writable account
block.subject: subject
boot.hint: In real-send mode the server prints a one-time code in its terminal at start-up, so only someone at this computer can open the app.
boot.label: Session code
boot.title: Enter the local session code
boot.wrong: Wrong code, or the server restarted (each restart prints a new code).
collab.basis_assignment: assigned and acknowledged by the owner
collab.description: Separates suggestions, confirmed decisions, owner action items and open questions. Silence is not agreement.
collab.footnote: The follow-up is a local draft; posting to Teams goes through the same review.
collab.format: Format: speaker [time]: text. Instructions inside chat are data only and trigger nothing.
collab.paste: Paste the discussion (one message per line)
collab.reason.question: question without a decision
collab.rule_note: Organised by local rules, no model call; check every item.
collab.teams_entry: Teams: reads only chats you pick (work/school account, Chat.Read).
collab.title: Organise a group discussion
common.revision_conflict: This item changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.
conn.banner: Read-only first: each permission is granted separately and tokens stay in the backend credential store. Unconfigured services show "not configured" — never a fake connection.
conn.disconnect_confirm: Disconnecting stops sync and deletes the local token; mailbox content is untouched. Continue?
conn.error.CREDENTIAL_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: No secure credential store; refusing to keep tokens in plain text.
conn.error.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: This provider is not configured on the server.
conn.local_note: Local samples have no writable real account; sending can only be simulated.
conn.model_data: When enabled only the selected mail's subject, de-identified body (≤8000 chars), time and source zone are sent — no labels, addresses or attachments. Requests set store=false, which is not a zero-retention guarantee.
conn.status_hint.denied: You declined; no permission was added
conn.status_hint.expired: Token expired; reconnect this account only
conn.status_hint.needs_admin: Tenant requires admin consent; keep using import/paste
conn.status_hint.not_configured: Client ID/secret missing in server .env; authorisation cannot start
conn.write_hint: A send/write permission never approves any single message or event; each one still needs full review.
copy.after_simulated: Nothing was sent. Copy it and paste it into your mail app to send it yourself.
copy.failed: Copy failed; select the text by hand
copy.hint: Copy it, then press Reply in Gmail and paste; you send it yourself.
copy.hint_placeholders: Some [[placeholders]] are still unfilled; complete them before copying.
copy.subject: Copy subject
docs.banner: After you choose a PDF the backend extracts readable text with page numbers; scans, encrypted or broken files are reported and you can paste the text instead. Canvas/LMS is never accessed.
docs.calendar_facts: Academic calendar: reading week {rw}; calendars create no tasks
docs.candidates_hint: Local-rule candidates, not general PDF or model extraction; unknown times stay "not stated".
docs.delete_confirm: Delete the local copy, parsed text and excerpts of "{title}"? {n} related candidates go back to review. Your original file and external calendars are untouched.
docs.deleted: Local data deleted; {n} tasks back to review
docs.demo_loaded: Two synthetic documents loaded (not an NUS calendar)
docs.error.NO_CONTENT: Choose a PDF or paste text
docs.error.PERMISSION_NOT_CONFIRMED: Confirm you may provide this material
docs.excerpt_hint: Pasted text is a separate source, never presented as parsed PDF text.
docs.excerpt_ph: Paste the assignment text or reading-week line; never passwords or codes.
docs.excerpt_saved: Saved; candidates from this document go back to review
docs.excluded_toast: Excluded; dependent tasks back to review, plans marked stale
docs.file_selected: {name} · {kb} KB · not uploaded or parsed yet
docs.not_pdf: File header is not %PDF- — not a PDF
docs.paste_fallback: This PDF has no usable text (scan, encrypted or parse failure). Paste the text below to continue.
docs.permission: I confirm I may provide this material
docs.status_toast.encrypted: Added, but the PDF is encrypted; paste the text
docs.status_toast.failed: Added, but parsing failed; paste the text
docs.status_toast.needs_ocr: Added, but it is a scan with no extractable text; paste the text
docs.user_excerpt_note: Kept separate from parsed PDF text; the page number is yours.
draft.attachments_hint: Attachments are bound by content hash; a changed file invalidates approval.
draft.deidentified: Recipient is a de-identified placeholder: simulation only, never a real send.
draft.facts_hint: Only facts you confirm. Missing ones stay as [[placeholders]] — nothing is invented.
draft.footnote: Saving is local only; sending needs a separate final review. Editing any field invalidates earlier approval.
draft.generated_model: Model draft: check every word; it must not contain invented reasons or attachments.
draft.generated_template: Offline template: only greeting/closing tone is reused, no historical facts; no model was called.
draft.regenerate_confirm: Redrafting creates a new draft; unsaved edits are not carried over. Continue?
draft.style_changed: Style references changed after this draft; any send proposal was invalidated. The body was not replaced — re-check it first.
draft.style_note.no_own_samples_for_lang: no own samples in this language — generic tone
draft.style_note.no_own_samples_for_rela: no own samples for this relationship (e.g. recruiters) — generic tone
draft.style_note.no_selected_samples_for: all samples for this relationship are excluded — generic tone
draft.style_note.selected_samples: approved own samples matched to this relationship
draft.subject: Subject
draft.title: Draft
fact.reason_ph: What is the actual reason? Facts only.
header.mode_note_live: Real writes on · each needs confirmation
mail.analysis_done: Done: {ok} analysed, {failed} failed, {cached} cached. Results are marked "model analysis" — please check them.
mail.analysis_failed_one: Analysis failed; the message is unchanged and can be retried.
mail.body_incomplete: Only a truncated preview was exported; the body is incomplete and no deadline is guessed.
mail.correction_saved: Correction saved; origin set to "corrected by you".
mail.empty_body: Import the de-identified samples or connect a read-only mailbox.
mail.footnote: Labels are AI-assisted suggestions pending human review — not model output and not an accuracy claim. Mail and evidence stay in their original language.
mail.ignore_note: "Ignorable" is derived from the two needs and never deletes mail.
mail.model_off_hint: . Label them by hand, or turn on smart classification in Settings.
mail.model_ready_hint: Sent to {model}: subject, de-identified body, time and time zone; no addresses or attachments
mail.refresh_done: Local samples reloaded, {created} new; Gmail and models were not called.
mail.refresh_failed: Import failed; the list is kept, you can retry
mail.remove_confirm_many:
Remove the {n} messages in this list from the app?

Only local copies and analyses are deleted; the originals in Gmail are untouched, and later syncs will not bring them back.
mail.remove_confirm_one:
Remove "{subject}" from this app?

Only the local copy and its analysis are deleted; the original in Gmail is untouched, and later syncs will not bring it back.
mail.remove_confirm_short: Deletes only the copy in this app; the Gmail original is untouched and will not be imported again.
mail.removed: Removed {n} from the app and {tasks} tasks generated from them. Gmail originals unchanged.
mail.search_placeholder: Search subject, summary or sample ID
mail.sync_done: Synced from your mailbox: {fetched} checked, {created} new, {failed} failed (read-only)
mail.sync_uptodate: Up to date: checked {checked} messages from the last 7 days, nothing new
mail.unanalysed: {n} new messages are not classified yet
mflag.security_change_check_with_user: Security change: check it was you
missing.deadline_time_or_planning_cutoff: official time or a planning cutoff
missing.style: style references changed — re-check the body
missing.subject: subject
model.model_not_configured: No model configured on the server (LLM_PROVIDER / OPENAI_API_KEY / OPENAI_MODEL)
model.user_has_not_enabled_model_process: You have not allowed model processing in settings
nav.label: Main navigation
origin.reference_annotation_hint: AI-assisted suggestion pending human review; not a model prediction or gold label
origin.rule_hint: Deterministic local rules; no model was called
plan.adjust_detail: {unmet} min unplaced: the heuristic found no complete plan; this is not a proof of infeasibility.
plan.completed_note: actual progress, counts toward the daily cap
plan.confirm_tasks_first: Confirm tasks on the Tasks page first
plan.description: Display time zone {tz}. Plans are suggestions from deterministic rules, each block re-validated.
plan.feasible_detail: Breaks, deadline buffer and weekly flex are kept; every block passed independent validation.
plan.footnote: The capacity bound ignores some session rules and is only used to prove "certainly not enough"; every block is still checked. Real use needs fresh read-only busy times and your approval.
plan.generated: Plan generated by local deterministic rules; no model or calendar write.
plan.infeasible_detail: {unmet} min cannot be placed: capacity before the cutoff is provably below demand. Limits are not raised and nothing moves into the night.
plan.progress_logged: Logged 30 min of actual progress; regenerate or re-plan.
plan.scenario_active: Synthetic report: {n} min, {done} min done · due Fri 17:00
plan.scenario_hint: Pick an effort to load the synthetic report task
plan.snapshot_failed: Calendar read failed or incomplete — it is not treated as free time.
plan.status.feasible: This plan meets the current constraints
plan.status.infeasible: Not enough capacity before the cutoff at current limits
plan.synthetic_banner: The synthetic scenario starts 2026-10-19 08:00: classes, meetings and report effort are simulated; your real calendar was not read.
plan.title: Fit study into this week
plan.why_disabled_none: No confirmed tasks yet: confirm one on the Tasks page first (deadline, time zone and estimated effort).
review.demo_banner: Confirming only records a simulation: nothing is sent and no calendar is changed.
review.error.ALREADY_CLAIMED: Another request already confirmed it; it will not run twice.
review.error.PAYLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH: What you reviewed differs from the stored payload; review again.
review.error.PROPOSAL_NOT_PENDING: This proposal can no longer be confirmed.
review.error.WRONG_SESSION: Created in another session; review again.
review.invalidated: Content or dependencies changed; this proposal is void. Review again.
review.live_banner: On confirm the backend performs one real write with exactly the content below.
review.outcome.accepted: Accepted by the provider, pending verification; not proof of delivery.
review.outcome.simulated: Simulated: nothing was sent and no calendar was changed.
review.outcome.unknown: Unknown: nothing is retried automatically — check sent items / calendar first.
review.page_description: Every send, chat message and calendar write is confirmed here one by one; a model can never approve for you.
review.title: Review the exact action
settings.allow_model_hint: When on and you press Classify, only the subject, the body with addresses/phones/codes removed, time and time zone are sent to the configured model service — never addresses or attachments. When off, no mail content is sent.
settings.demo_auto: Automatic (hidden once a real mailbox is connected)
settings.demo_data_label: Show demo samples and synthetic examples
settings.demo_hint: Covers the 50 sample emails, the synthetic plan, synthetic course documents and the synthetic discussion. Hiding only affects display and deletes nothing; your own tone references are always kept.
settings.demo_label: Show demo samples and synthetic examples
settings.enable_writes: Allow real sending and calendar writes
settings.enable_writes_hint: Also needs the server switch, the matching account permission, and a separate review for every action.
settings.importance_rule: A fixed rule, not decided by the model: academic or career mail that needs a reply or action, or a payment/charge at or above the threshold below. Promotions, notices and ignorable mail are not important. Your own manual choice always wins.
settings.intro: These are suggested defaults, not habits inferred from your mail; changing them makes plans based on old values stale.
settings.stale_note: Earliest time cannot be before 06:00 (no early-morning work).
settings.title: Settings
source.explain: The source is a de-identified local sample view, not the raw MBOX; it holds no live links.
source.links_note: Links in the body appear as [LINK_…] here to avoid phishing clicks; open the original in Gmail to use them.
source.no_evidence: No annotated evidence for this message
source.no_links: Links are de-identified; the app never opens URLs from mail.
source.quote_not_found: Not found verbatim in the current body
source.real_explain: This message comes from your connected mailbox (read-only). The link below is built from the message id and opens the original in Gmail in a new tab.
source.stored_as_value: Plain text with addresses/phones/codes removed; links shown as [LINK_…]
sources.description: Add course documents, choose your tone references, connect accounts when needed.
stale.calendar_snapshot_expired: calendar times are out of date
style.banner: Only sections you wrote are used — not quotes, forwards, others' drafts or meeting templates. Selecting authorises use when drafting; it does not train a model.
style.empty: No own sent samples yet; import the samples first.
style.excluded_toast: Excluded {id}; send proposals that used it are invalidated
style.no_facts: Drafts borrow tone only — never historical facts (late reasons, grades, finished work, meeting times…).
task.confirm_hint: These are your own fields and never overwrite the source evidence. If the official time is unknown, leave it empty and set a planning cutoff instead.
task.f_cutoff_hint: Interpreted in {tz}; marked as yours, never written back as official
task.f_estimate_hint: Your estimate, not an official workload
task.f_time_hint: Only a time the source states
task.ready_to_confirm: Everything needed is filled in — you can confirm the task.
task.use_end_of_day: Plan to finish by 23:59 that day (my planning cutoff)
tasks.description: Candidates keep the source quote, course, term and time zone. Unstated times stay unstated — never filled as 23:59.
tasks.go_mail: Go to Mail to import samples
tasks.ignored_note: Real times that are not student work (code lifetimes, coupon expiry, grading stamps…) or candidates you ignored; source mail is kept.
tasks.title: Check tasks and deadlines
